adHighCpu.description: Triggers high cpu load in the ad service

adManualGc.description: Triggers full manual garbage collections in the ad service

cartFailure.description: Fail cart service n% of the time

emailMemoryLeak.description: Memory leak in the email service.

failedReadinessProbe.description: readiness probe failure for cart service

imageSlowLoad.description: slow loading images in the frontend

intlShippingSlowdown.description: Delays international shipping responses to simulate overseas shipping delay

kafkaConsumerDead.description: fraud-detection leaves the orders consumer group (unsubscribes and stops polling) while checkout keeps producing, so the group empties (members -> 0) and lag climbs against a zero-member group

kafkaQueueProblems.description: Throttles the fraud-detection consumer by sleeping N ms per consumed record (value = per-record delay in ms). Drains slower than checkout produces, so consumer lag climbs. Tune the delay live from this flag.

loadGeneratorTraffic.description: Enable synthetic traffic from the load generator. Turn off to pause all load-generator scenarios.

loadGeneratorVUs.description: Number of concurrent virtual users the load generator's HTTP scenario runs. Changes take effect on the wrapper's next poll, restarting k6.

paymentFailure.description: Fail payment service charge requests n%

productCatalogFailure.description: Fail product catalog service on a specific product
